realizes.rationale: Gives the header's refresh control `refreshReview` and the surface's failure block `retryReview` and `openTaskContext`, so the governed refresh, the retry of a failed refresh and the task-context offer set the tree intent; an ordinary retry of a failed read that was not a failed refresh reads again without setting it.
It only enriches the stored opened page when task, number and generation match.
Creates the named shared Tree sidebar control with aria-controls=review-tree and passes it to ReadingColumn, beside the crumb, rather than mounting it in the tree it hides.
It stores the complete comparison task, generation, number, inventory and held lane at opening.

Its `refreshReview` leaves a request that only scrolls and remembers the read on screen at the click. Its `settle` drops that request when the read on screen is failed or refused and is not the one remembered, and remembers that read as the refresh's failure. Its `retryReview` settles first and then is the refresh again when the read on screen is that failure; otherwise it only reads again. The cases "forgets the scroll a refresh asked for when its read fails, so a later page of the subject leaves the rail alone", "brings the selected row into view after a refresh asked in the turn that shows a failed read" and "brings the selected row into view when the retry is made in the turn that shows the failed refresh" of `dashboard/src/panels/review/ReviewSurface.walkFresh.test.tsx` test these three paths.

Its `refreshReview` begins a selection that does not keep before it asks the read cycle to read again, so a refresh shows the comparison as it reads now and not the tree walked before it. The case "starts afresh at a refresh of the review" of `dashboard/src/panels/review/ReviewSurface.walkFresh.test.tsx` tests it.
It retains an explicit unavailable page state instead of silently ignoring All.
Passes the same review-tree open state to ReviewGrid and the PageReading control, so the control outside the tree changes the tree track rather than creating a second toggle owner.

Builds the selection handlers and the refresh and retry handlers over the one workspace state and the one read cycle, and hands the failure block the retry and the offer of the task context. The governed refresh entry and the task-context offer go through the handlers that set the tree intent; the ordinary retry and the page controls are wired directly to the read and the selection setter.
It retains the mounted workspace and opener while the page is active, then restores focus without changing the review question.
The review tree uses the remembered review/left choice while the chat control remains supplied by the shell.
Turns an unanswered read (pending, failed or refused) into the reading status bound to the requested question's key and subject label, carrying the owner's problem block for a failure or refusal.
